_comment: Known-good vendor for the Task 0 retrieval-survival pre-flight.
Pebble Technology Corp shipped Kickstarter-funded e-paper smartwatches
from 2013 until December 2016, when the company filed for insolvency
and sold its software/IP to Fitbit. The pitch fixture mirrors a hardware
wearable Kickstarter play, so a healthy retrieval pipeline must surface
this vendor when its body is persisted into an empty corpus.
(captured pre-shutdown homepage describing the smartwatch product line)
Citation URL is discovered at L0 by the Tavily search head, not pinned
in this fixture — the Wikipedia article on Pebble (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pebble_(watch))
is the canonical death citation in the survival_news_body.html companion.
Companion fixtures captured on 2026-05-10 from the URLs above:
survival_wayback_body.txt  - extract_clean output of the Wayback homepage (~1.2KB)
survival_news_body.html    - trimmed Wikipedia article HTML (lead + closure section)
